opportunities.title: Small Grants (UK office)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds; applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, humanities, Japanese language, medicine, health, science, youth, education, sport and related fields.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year (maximum £30,000 total for up to three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; open to researchers, practitioners, managers, carers in health‑related fields who can demonstrate UK‑Japan collaboration; preference for early‑career applicants and those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Awards support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering research, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
